proves.claim: A person-channel spec apply --row call whose pending same-channel decision is a decline is refused COORDINATOR_ONLY.

cli.io-commands-spec-apply-row.decline-r.why: Without it, a regression where a pending decline opens the person-channel apply would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A person-channel spec apply --row --commit call with a pending same-channel approve is allowed.

cli.io-commands-spec-apply-row.approve-a.why: Without it, a regression where the guard refuses a real approve would pass unnoticed.
